competencies.name: Problem Solving
competencies.description: Ability to analyze complex problems, decompose them into manageable components, and formulate effective, scalable solutions.

rubric.1-3: Struggles to isolate the root cause, offers superficial solutions without considering trade-offs.
rubric.4-6: Identifies the core problem, proposes viable solutions with basic reasoning, acknowledges some edge cases.
rubric.7-8: Deconstructs problems methodically, evaluates multiple architectural/algorithmic trade-offs, anticipates failure modes.
rubric.9-10: Demonstrates exceptional systematic thinking, designs robust, elegant solutions under tight constraints with quantitative justifications.

competencies.name: Communication & Clarity
competencies.description: Ability to articulate technical concepts, decisions, and narratives clearly, concisely, and coherently to diverse audiences.

rubric.1-3: Rambles, uses excessive filler words, loses track of the question, fails to structure thoughts.
rubric.4-6: Answers the prompt clearly with minor tangents, reasonable vocabulary, understandable structure.
rubric.7-8: Succinct, well-organized (Situation-Task-Action-Result or top-down), precise terminology, highly engaging.
rubric.9-10: Masterful storytelling and clarity, tailors explanations dynamically, zero unnecessary fluff, compelling flow.

competencies.name: Technical Depth & Domain Mastery
competencies.description: Thorough understanding of relevant technologies, architecture, design patterns, protocols, and best practices.

rubric.1-3: Lacks fundamental domain knowledge, provides incorrect technical explanations or buzzword soup.
rubric.4-6: Understands core concepts, uses standard frameworks correctly, explains common patterns.
rubric.7-8: Deep understanding of internal mechanisms, concurrency, memory, optimization, and system design.
rubric.9-10: Recognized expert depth, cites real-world production performance trade-offs, internal runtimes, and distributed limits.

competencies.name: Ownership & Accountability
competencies.description: Demonstrating personal initiative, responsibility for outcomes, and commitment beyond strictly assigned duties.

rubric.1-3: Blames others, speaks exclusively in vague 'we' terms without clarifying personal role, avoids responsibility.
rubric.4-6: Explains assigned tasks and deliverables clearly, accepts responsibility for own work.
rubric.7-8: Takes proactive steps before being asked, unblocks teammates, follows through to final post-mortem.
rubric.9-10: Drives organizational change, advocates for users and code health, takes total ownership in crises.

competencies.name: Teamwork & Conflict Resolution
competencies.description: Collaborating effectively with cross-functional partners, resolving technical disagreements constructively, and supporting team goals.

rubric.1-3: Defensive, dismissive of other perspectives, escalates prematurely, creates team friction.
rubric.4-6: Cooperates with teammates, listens to counterarguments, reaches compromise through discussion.
rubric.7-8: De-escalates friction objectively using data, builds consensus across stakeholders, mentors junior colleagues.
rubric.9-10: Fosters high psychological safety, elevates entire team standards, navigates complex organizational politics seamlessly.

competencies.name: Adaptability & Resilience
competencies.description: Handling shifting requirements, recovering from failures, embracing feedback, and learning rapidly in ambiguous environments.

rubric.1-3: Resists change, freezes under ambiguity, becomes defensive when given critical feedback.
rubric.4-6: Adjusts to plan changes with minor guidance, acknowledges mistakes, incorporates feedback.
rubric.7-8: Thrives in ambiguous environments, pivots quickly with minimal context, turns failures into post-mortem lessons.
rubric.9-10: Inspires calm and direction during rapid change, masters brand-new domains overnight, seeks out tough feedback.
